title: Cannot connect to shared network printer
symptom: Windows cannot connect to a shared printer
user_description: I tried to add the department printer and it says 'Windows cannot connect to the printer'. Other people can use it.

options.why: Moves the problem and creates a second printer to look after. It does not fix why he cannot reach the shared one.

options.text: Turn off the firewall on his PC to see if it helps
options.why: Removes protection and is rarely the cause. Check the network and the printer path first.

options.text: Confirm he is on the office network, check the printer is reachable by its name or address, and remove and add the printer again from the print server
options.why: Other people can print, so the printer works. Checking his network connection and that he can reach the printer, then re-adding it correctly, finds most connection faults.
Drastic and unnecessary. Never start with the most destructive fix.

hints: Others can print, so where is the likely problem: the printer or this PC?
Can his PC reach the printer or print server at all?
What would you do if the saved printer connection is damaged?
real_world_tip: If you can open the printer's name in File Explorer or ping it, the network path is fine and the fault is in the printer connection on the PC.
